facts.text: Under the Guaranteed Tuition Plan, Illinois undergraduate students pay a per-credit-hour tuition rate in their first term that remains the same for each of the following consecutive eleven terms.

sources.title: Tuition and Fee Payment Policies - Governors State University
sources.quote: the tuition for undergraduate students who are Illinois residents is assessed at a per-credit-hour tuition rate during the term they first register and the same tuition rate will apply for each of the following consecutive eleven terms
